project.name: Inheritance Fixture
project.description:
Jawata-owned fixture for Sprint 28d: the PROOF OF LIFE corpus for the `composition_over_inheritance` detector, which flags a class extending a CONCRETE, source-declared class that either overrides nothing of it or touches fewer than `threshold`% (default 25) of its inherited surface.
It lives in its OWN project rather than in simple-maven because the exclusions it must demonstrate (a source-declared concrete Throwable parent, a refused-bequest subclass, a class extending a JDK type) need deliberately shaped supertypes, and because adding classes to a shared corpus moves numbers other detectors' tests read off that corpus.
InheritanceTargets.java — the parent `Ledger` bequeaths SIX inheritable members (field balance; total(), credit(int), debit(int), describe(), isEmpty()). Expected: exactly TWO findings. ReportingLedger — overrides NOTHING of Ledger (uses 2 of 6 = 33%, so the percentage arm does not fire; the no-override arm does). AuditLedger — overrides describe() and touches ONLY describe(): 1 of 6 = 16%, below the 25% threshold. FullLedger — overrides 3 and touches all 6 (100%). NOT flagged.
InheritanceCleanTargets.java — every documented exclusion, each shaped so that it WOULD be flagged if its exclusion were removed. Expected: ZERO. Dot — parent Shape is ABSTRACT (Template Method). MissingAccount — parent DomainFailure is a concrete SOURCE class, but it is a Throwable: subclassing IS the mechanism. Names — parent is outside the scanned source (java.util). ReadOnlyLedger — refuses a bequest, so refused_bequest owns it. Shape — extends nothing at all.
